summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 38 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic rolled Sonnet 5 out across all tiers: it's now the default on Free and Pro, and available to Max, Team, and Enterprise, live across every Claude app and the Claude Platform, with introductory pricing through August 31. The key framing: Sonnet 5 is a substantial improvement over Sonnet 4.6 on reasoning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work — with performance close to Opus 4.8 at lower prices. Early-access partners found it finishes complex tasks where previous Sonnets stopped short, checks its own output…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 正式把 Sonnet 5 铺到所有档位：Free 和 Pro 用户现在默认就是 Sonnet 5，Max、Team、Enterprise 也全部可用，覆盖所有 Claude App 和 Claude Platform，8 月 31 日前有介绍性折扣价。官方给的定位很关键——Sonnet 5 在推理、工具调用、编码和知识工作上相比 Sonnet 4.6 是「实质性提升」，性能已经逼近 Opus 4.8，但价格低不少。早期合作伙伴反馈它能在此前 Sonnet 会中途放弃的复杂任务上做完，还会不用提醒就自查输出，且整个 agentic 流程都跑在很有吸引力的价位上。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code
featured.summaryEn: Boris Cherny from the Claude Code team announced a long-requested feature: Claude Desktop is now available on Linux. "You asked, we listened" — a concrete usability gap finally closed for the developer crowd who work primarily on Linux.
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Boris Cherny 宣布了一个被催了很久的功能：Claude Desktop 正式登陆 Linux。用户长期呼吁，这次终于落地——对以 Linux 为主力开发环境的工程师群体是个实打实的可用性补齐。

featured.title: Why Hardware-Software Co-Design Is AI's Real 100x: Dylan Patel of SemiAnalysis
featured.summaryEn: AI's real 100x comes from hardware-software co-design, not any single chip or library. The CUDA moat is partially disentangled, and the future is a multipolar world of many chip types and many model architectures — with Chinese open source models quietly becoming the substrate of the global inference ecosystem. On Sequoia's Training Data, SemiAnalysis founder Dylan Patel crystallized the central through-line of recent AI infrastructure: the real efficiency revolution lives in the co-design of hardware and software, not either alone. His headline number: model cost for equivalent quality drops ~60x per year, compounded by a relentless cadence — inference libraries like PyTorch, VLM, and SGLang update roughly twice a week. Because performance changes daily, SemiAnalysis built InferenceMAX, a "living" benchmark running on 15+ chip types and over $50M (soon $100M+ with TPUs/Trainium) of don…
featured.insightZh: AI 真正的 100 倍红利来自「硬件-软件协同设计」，CUDA 护城河正在部分瓦解，未来是多种芯片、多种模型架构共存的多极世界——而中国开源模型正在悄悄成为全球推理生态的地基。 SemiAnalysis 创始人 Dylan Patel 在 Sequoia 的 Training Data 播客里，把过去几年 AI 基础设施最核心的一条主线讲透了：真正的效率革命不在单一硬件或单一软件，而在两者的协同设计。他用一个数字点题——同等质量下，模型成本每年下降约 60 倍，靠的是硬件、驱动、推理库（PyTorch、VLM、SGLang）每周两次的更新节奏叠加出来的「相对论般」复利。正因为性能天天在变，SemiAnalysis 搞了 InferenceMAX：一个「活的」基准测试项目，拿到 CoreWeave、Oracle、微软、亚马逊、Google、OpenAI 捐的超 5000 万美元（加上 TPU/Trainium 后将超 1 亿美元）硬件、约 15 种芯片，每天自动跑所有最新模型，产出公开的帕累托最优曲线——因为大家过去比推理性能常拿别人的次优点比自己的最优点，等于「开保时捷的你和赛车手比」。 关于 CUDA 护城河，Patel 的判断很清醒：软件护城河至少部分被瓦解了，因为模型编码能力太强、所有软件都会被商品化。但真正的「CUDA moat」其实和 CUDA 无关——它是指 DeepSeek、Kimi、Zip2AI、阿里、腾讯、小米这些中国开源模型是「为 GPU 协同设计的」，搬到 TPU 上有时跑不好；于是下游的推理 API 商、RL 定制公司都被迫用 NVIDIA。GPU 与 TPU 的取舍则回到协同设计本身：OpenAI 的模型更稀疏、Anthropic 的更偏稠密，矩阵乘单元大小、注意力机制、网络拓扑（NVLink 只能连 72 个 GPU，Google 的 ICI 无交换机却能连 8000 芯片）全都互相牵制，无法孤立地说谁更好。 对算力紧缺，Patel 认为短期无解：每季度部署的算力都远超上季度，今年约 20GW、明年超 30GW（已计入延误），但 Fabl…

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq, also from Claude Code, clarified the recent controversy over updated safety classifiers: as with the original ones, a small fraction of routine coding and debugging tasks get flagged and fall back to Opus. The team is continuing to refine these safeguards to better distinguish genuine misuse from legitimate requests and reduce false positives — a direct response to community concern about safety guardrails occasionally catching normal dev work.
items.insightZh: 同样来自 Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 就近期更新的「分类器/安全防护」争议做了澄清：和最初的分类器一样，一小部分常规编码和调试任务会被标记并回退到 Opus。团队正持续打磨这些防护措施，目标是更好地区分真正的滥用和合法请求、减少误报（false positives）。这条回应指向了社区对模型安全护栏偶尔误伤正常开发任务的普遍关切。

items.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru offered a sharp diagnosis of why traditional PMs struggle to adapt to AI-native building: a lack of "magical thinking." A decade of frameworks, "agile," and metric obsession has bred constraint-first, incremental thinking. His fix was to ask teams to imagine they had tech from 100 years in the future and work backward from the experiences it would enable — the ideas were always far more creative. The funny thing: that technology from the future is here now. So go build that magical thing.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 对传统 PM 转型 AI-native 建构给了个挺狠的诊断：最大的障碍是缺乏「魔法思维（magical thinking）」。十年的框架、「敏捷」和指标崇拜养成了约束优先、增量式的思维定式。他过去在团队里的破解办法是让大家想象「假如我们拥有 100 年后的技术，会催生什么体验」，然后从那个未来倒推——这样出来的点子总是更有创造力。而有意思的是，那个「来自未来的技术」现在真的到了，所以：去建那个魔法般的东西吧。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie had a dense week with three posts worth reading. First, on the Fable / upcoming GPT-5.6 release drama: he sees the current situation as setting the precedent for how frontier model releases (at least those with significant coding and cyber capabilities) will look going forward, extending to bio and other risk categories flagged by AI safety groups; Anthropic proposes a shared industry framework with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and others to assess and fix "jailbreaks," plus deeper US-government pre-relea…
items.insightZh: Box 的 Aaron Levie 这周输出密集，三条都值得看。其一，围绕 Fable / 未来 GPT-5.6 的发布争议，他认为现在已经为前沿模型（尤其具备重大编码和网络安全能力的）确立了发布先例，这套逻辑会延伸到生物等其它被 AI 安全组织识别出的风险类别；Anthropic 提出要和 Amazon、微软、Google 等共建一个评估和修复「越狱（jailbreak）」的行业统一框架，并深化与美国政府的发布前测试合作——过程很乱，但至少有了个雏形，只是隐忧是各类风险的可利用性判断主观性很强，未来每次重大发布可能都要反复审查。其二，他把 Sonnet 5 跑了 Box AI 复杂工作评测，Sonnet 5 保持前沿级质量，在能源（+4.7pp）、零售（+4.4pp）、专业服务（+2.6pp）等企业场景领先 Sonnet 4.6，能从原始资产负债表算出流动性和杠杆比率、抓出文档自身低估的负债权益比。其三，关于 AI 与就业，Ramp 和 Box 对 1600+ 中大型公司的调研都显示：AI 采纳越深的公司反而招人越多——58% 受访者预期未来三年扩编，在最成熟的 AI 采纳者里这个比例升到 79%，「AI 采纳导致裁员」…

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit's Amjad Masad flagged a structural reason AI is expensive to run: most workloads today run on generic hardware designed pre-LLMs. He highlighted Etched — billed as the first system designed from the ground up for modern inference. This echoes the hardware-software co-design theme Dylan Patel hammers on in this issue's podcast.
items.insightZh: Replit 的 Amjad Masad 点出了 AI 推理成本高的一个结构性原因：今天大部分工作负载还跑在 LLM 出现之前设计的通用硬件上。他推 Etched——号称是第一个从头为现代推理设计的系统。这条呼应了本期播客里 Dylan Patel 反复强调的「硬件-软件协同设计」主题。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel's Guillermo Rauch launched Vercel Services: you can now collocate e.g. a Python backend API, an ExpressJS server, and a React SPA in one Vercel project — run it all locally with `vc dev`, deploy and rollback all at once, observe/monitor/debug together, with internal networking. He also shared a tech exec relaying both his company's and his 12-year-old son's Vercel feedback ("Vercel is for everyone"), and working with Shopify to push the agentic web forward.
items.insightZh: Vercel 的 Guillermo Rauch 发布了 Vercel Services：现在可以把 Python 后端 API、ExpressJS 服务器、React SPA 等多个服务并置（collocate）在同一个 Vercel 项目里——本地用 `vc dev` 一起跑，一次性部署和回滚，一起观测/监控/调试，还有内部网络。他还分享了两个小故事：一位科技高管在晚餐上转述自己公司和 12 岁儿子对 Vercel 的反馈（「Vercel 属于所有人」），以及和 Shopify 团队合作推进 agentic web。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan shared a practical note on his GBrain: it's mostly useful once you have 10,000+ markdown files in your personal or company brain. In other words, the value of personal-knowledge-base tooling scales non-linearly — marginal at small volumes, transformative at massive note counts.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 分享了他自研的 GBrain 的一个实用心得：GBrain 主要在你个人或公司「大脑」里有 10,000+ 个 markdown 文件时才真正发挥价值。换句话说，个人知识库工具的价值随规模非线性放大——小体量时收益不明显，海量笔记时才见真章。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal captured a striking state of the world in one line: it's very strange that the models powering innovation in the USA are Chinese open source models. Short but precise — it lands exactly on the reality Dylan Patel keeps returning to in this issue's podcast: open models from DeepSeek, Kimi, Alibaba, Tencent, and Xiaomi are becoming the substrate of the entire downstream ecosystem.
items.insightZh: Aditya Agarwal 一句话点出了当下一个耐人寻味的世界格局：驱动美国创新的模型，居然是中国的开源模型。这条虽短，但精准戳中了本期播客里 Dylan Patel 反复提到的现实——DeepSeek、Kimi、阿里、腾讯、小米的开源模型正在成为整个下游生态的地基。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw + OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger dropped a line that's increasingly central to AI cost debates: price per token!= cost per task. A reminder not to fixate on token pricing — a pricier but smarter model may finish a task in fewer steps and fewer retries, making the real per-task cost lower. It's the flip side of the "fast mode costs way more than regular mode but is worth it for certain tasks" logic Dylan Patel discusses in this issue's podcast.
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 抛出了一句在 AI 成本讨论里越来越重要的判断：每 token 单价 ≠ 每任务成本（Price per token!= cost per task）。这提醒大家别只盯着 token 报价——一个更贵但更聪明的模型可能用更少步数、更少重试就把任务干完，实际每任务成本反而更低。这也正是本期 Dylan Patel 播客里「快速模式比常规模式贵得多但对某些任务值得」逻辑的另一面。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 主理人
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang amplified an insight on taste: taste isn't valuable because it's impossible to copy — taste is valuable exactly because it defines what everyone else chooses to copy. In an era where anyone can generate and imitate quickly with AI, this points at what's actually scarce: not execution, but judgment and direction.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 引用并放大了一句关于「品味（taste）」的洞见：品味的价值不在于它无法被复制，恰恰相反，品味之所以有价值，正因为它定义了其他所有人选择去复制的对象。在人人都能靠 AI 快速生成和模仿的时代，这句话直指真正稀缺的东西——不是执行力，而是判断力和方向感。

items.title: Peter Yang · 实用 AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang's week centered on the anticipated Fable model launch: he set a midnight alarm to get Fable to fix all his projects, joking he had no idea whether it was actually dropping at midnight. This lightly self-deprecating thread captures the genuine mix of excitement and restlessness in the SF developer community around a new frontier model release.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 这周的动态围绕新模型 Fable 的发布：他半夜设闹钟等 Fable 上线来修复自己所有的项目，还调侃自己完全不知道会不会午夜准时发。这组带点自嘲的推文，捕捉到了旧金山开发者社区对新前沿模型发布那种既兴奋又焦躁的真实氛围。
